West Palm Beach: Spanish 19.7%; French, Haitian or Cajun 5.8%; other Indo-European 1.9%. title: Fla. Admin. Code R. 64B5-4.002 – Advertising and Soliciting by Dentists (LII reproduction)
publisher: Legal Information Institute, Cornell Law School
measures: Rule text: applies to media exposure of any nature, paid or not; all advertising must identify the Florida-licensed dentist who assumes total responsibility (license number, or commonly used name with the address and phone on file with the Department); prohibits false, deceptive or misleading advertising including laudatory statements, quality comparisons, unjustified expectations of results and appeals primarily to a layperson's fears; prohibits in-person and telephone solicitation by a dentist or agent (scheduling and follow-up with patients or former patients excepted); bars naming people who neither practise at the advertised location nor own the practice (previous owner up to 2 years with written permission); referral-service statements; 'sleep dentistry' only with a general anesthesia permit.
limitations: Unofficial reproduction, used at independent review because the official FLRules page returned HTTP 403 (bot challenge) on 2026-11-08 and was not bypassed. LII's history ends at 2-26-06, so it may not reflect the 2026 amendments recorded by the writer; pages therefore describe only provisions present in both and tell readers to check the current official text.
